title: Features
intro: Turn off what your event doesn't use. A feature that is off leaves the menus, its pages and API answer "not found", and its background checks stop. Nothing is deleted: turn it back on and its data is still there.
forced: Turned off on the server ({{env}}). Change it there.

desc.incidents: The incident board for problems at seats and switches.
desc.helpdesk: Players report a problem from the QR code at their seat.
desc.dispatch: Send incidents to techs, with their own job list on the phone.
desc.handover: What the next shift needs to know, with a note from the last one.
desc.gear: Who has which switch or access point, with QR labels.
desc.health: DHCP, DNS, the game cache and other services, from health plugins.
desc.dashboard: Tiles from plugins on one page.
desc.traffic: What the hall's traffic is made of. Turning it off also stops the NetFlow collector keeping anything.
desc.dns: What the hall looks up: top sites, categories and blocked lookups. Hall-wide only.
desc.syslog: Logs from switches, firewalls and DHCP servers, kept for a day and searchable.
desc.games: What the hall plays and downloads, and what the LAN cache saved.
desc.forecast: Expected bandwidth for the next hours, with a warning before the line fills.
desc.security: Rogue DHCP, ARP spoofing, MAC flapping, loops and storms.
desc.ports: Bounce or shut a seat's switch port, with the tech's own switch login.
desc.terminal: A terminal on one switch in the browser, with the tech's own login. Every line typed is audited.
desc.commands: Saved show commands on one or many switches, output side by side. Leads also run commands that change something.
desc.tournament: Match seats and their QoS hints.
desc.replay: Play the event back on the floor plan.
desc.report: The post-event report with its PDF.
desc.past_events: Keep each event and compare them side by side.
desc.planner: Plan switches per seat block and render their configs.
desc.preflight: The go or no-go board before doors open.
desc.teardown: Gear back, configs archived and the event exported.
desc.public_hall: The hall map players see without signing in.
